description: Linux kernel driver source code for Intel SmartPHY DSL PCIe Endpoint/ACA, including firmware handling, hardware initialization, DMA setup, and control functions for ACA hardware.

methods.name: aca_fetch_fw_file
methods.description: Fetch firmware file from filesystem based on directory and filename.

methods.name: aca_fw_parse
methods.description: Parse firmware image headers and addresses.

methods.name: aca_section_parse
methods.description: Parse firmware sections including SRAM, DMA, and init data.

methods.name: aca_fetch_fw_api
methods.description: Fetch and parse firmware file, validate headers.

methods.name: aca_fw_download
methods.description: Download firmware to hardware via memory writes.

methods.name: aca_xbar_ia_reject_set
methods.description: Set reject bit for XBAR IA.

methods.name: aca_xbar_ia_reject_clr
methods.description: Clear reject bit for XBAR IA.

methods.name: aca_mem_clear
methods.description: Clear ACA SRAM and firmware memory.

methods.name: dc_aca_start
methods.description: Start ACA functions with specified task mask.

methods.name: dc_aca_stop
methods.description: Stop ACA functions, optionally reset hardware.

methods.name: aca_grx330_init
methods.description: Initialize specific hardware configuration for XWAY SOC.

methods.name: dc_aca_init
methods.description: Main initialization routine for ACA, including firmware fetch, memory setup, DMA, and hardware init.

methods.name: aca_umt_msg_addr
methods.description: Get UMT message address based on endianness and type.
